title: Super Mario World - Midway Point / Goal Point Styled Pipes
description:
This is a very specific pipe to be honest, but it can be used to indicate the end of a special level, or to be used in a Switch Palace level. It contains 4 palette variants.

Credit would be great, but it's optional. And it's my first original graphics.

Requested by Anorakun.
